summary: Frontend-only testing of GestorCred PWA new features: (1) manifest maskable icons, (2) manifest shortcuts, (3) iOS install instructions banner. All 6 test scenarios PASSED. No issues found.

tests_executed.name: Manifest maskable icons present with purpose=maskable
tests_executed.detail: icon-maskable-192.png and icon-maskable-512.png both HTTP 200 with content-type image/png; 'any' logos still present

tests_executed.name: iOS banner appears on iPhone UA after ~1.5s
tests_executed.detail: data-testid='pwa-ios-banner' visible with title 'Instalar na Tela de Início', 3 numbered steps (Compartilhar, Adicionar à Tela de Início, Adicionar), dismiss button present

tests_executed.name: Dismiss persistence iOS
tests_executed.detail: Clicking dismiss stored localStorage 'pwa_ios_dismissed_until' with future timestamp (1789433673724); banner did NOT reappear after reload with same iPhone UA

tests_executed.name: iOS banner NOT on desktop UA
tests_executed.detail: With Chrome/Windows UA the banner did not appear

tests_executed.name: Regression: beforeinstallprompt + pwa-update-available synthetic events
tests_executed.detail: pwa-install-banner and pwa-update-banner both appear on synthetic dispatch; no new console errors

context_for_next_testing_agent: PWAManager.js handles iOS UA detection at mount via navigator.userAgent. To test the iOS banner, playwright must create a new browser context with iPhone user_agent BEFORE navigation. Dismiss uses localStorage key 'pwa_ios_dismissed_until' (7 day duration). Same file also owns synthetic beforeinstallprompt install-banner and pwa-update-available update-banner. Manifest maskable icons at /icon-maskable-{192,512}.png return image/png 200 OK.
